title: Psalm 124: If the LORD Had Not Been on Our Side
summary: Israel is invited to say aloud what would have happened if the LORD had not been on its side: enemies would have swallowed the nation alive, and floodwaters would have swept it away. Instead the people praise God, who did not hand them over as prey, and who tore the net so they escaped like a bird from a trap. Their help, they confess, is in the name of the Maker of heaven and earth.

line: The people say aloud what would have happened without the LORD on their side: they escaped like a bird from a torn net, and their help is in his name.
guide: Finish the psalm's opening line about your own life: where would you be? Most people can name a moment when the net tore. Say it aloud, together, so that the next generation knows.

stanzas.title: If the LORD had not been on our side
What would have happened: swallowed and swept away
Praise for rescue: not prey, but an escaped bird
Our help is in the name of the LORD

verses.t: A song of ascents. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare—
if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,
when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,
then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
then the raging waters would have swept us away.
Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
